findings.summary: Round three's wrong COUNT of claim sites is replaced by a command asserted to be authoritative -- grep -rn "correctness hole" . is the list -- and the command is not the list: it is case-sensitive so it misses the two uppercase source sites, and it misses three of the five live SPEC/roadmap claims because they use different wording.
findings.failure_scenario: Run the command verbatim after this commit: the non-verdict hits are ForwardingIngestTest.java:31 (the pointer itself), two override prose lines, RemoteSequencer.java:24 and backlog.md:40 (both already corrected by this diff), and only two live claims -- SPEC.md:11 and SPEC.md:377. It does NOT return FleetSequencerTest.java:28 (uppercase) -- the exact fifth site round three had to force in, and the site this very diff edits -- nor RemoteSequencerTest.java:22 (uppercase, a sixth site no round has named), nor SPEC.md:5, nor SPEC.md:18, nor roadmap.md:14. Concretely: an agent at M5.20, told by this javadoc that the grep IS the list, corrects SPEC.md:11 and :377 and stops -- leaving SPEC.md:5, SPEC.md:18 and roadmap.md:14 still asserting the milestone makes a multi-pod deployment correct, precisely the partial sweep round three described. Minor only because the enumeration on backlog.md:46 (M5.6e) names all five with exact line numbers and each resolves; the defect is that the two records disagree and the javadoc's is the wrong one.

findings.summary: Round three's R2 -- that citing (M2.1) for the missing production main() presents as owned a gap no row owns -- was fixed in RemoteSequencer.java and recorded on the new M5.6e row, but the two backlog rows the finding also named still carry the bare (M2.1) citation, so the override's claim that this round stops citing a done row as owning the missing main() is not true of the backlog.
findings.failure_scenario: backlog.md:40 (M5.6) reads it needs a production SequencerTransport (M5.6e) and a production main() (M2.1), and backlog.md:43 (M5.6b, the row this commit marks done) reads there is no production main() to assemble any of it (M2.1). backlog.md:197 is the only M2.1 row, is marked done, and is about Capabilities.conditionalWrites. grep -rn 'public static void main' --include=*.java . returns nothing, so the gap is real and unowned. An agent running next-task or milestone-review opens M5.6 or M5.6b, follows the (M2.1) pointer, finds a row marked done, and concludes the service entry point is accounted for -- the identical outcome round three's R2 named. The correction exists only on backlog.md:46, three rows away, and neither citing row links to it.
